title: hotline v2 transport frames (CLI<->app, end-to-end through the dumb pipe)
description: Every frame is a JSON object with exact-lowercase key 't'. Receivers match 't' by exact byte comparison, ignore unknown 't' values, and ignore unknown fields on known frames. All cursors are decimal strings (BigInt-safe). Two families live here: the durable/session frames, and the TRANSIENT content family (agent_state, agent_catalog, typing, read, sdk_config_result, fleet_state) - seq'd, never durable, never acked, never replayed, and additive, so an app that does not know one drops it. The transient seq is drawn from the box's shared server->app sequence, so emitting a transient advances the counter the next DURABLE frame will use; it never writes a durable record, moves a mailbox head, or queues a mailbox item.

harness.description: optional box identity metadata: harness kind (claude = the TUI, claude-sdk, pi, opencode); absent = unknown (old boxes)

model.description: optional: resolved or configured model id, e.g. claude-opus-4-8; absent = unknown

effort.description: optional: operator effort knob verbatim, e.g. xhigh; absent = unknown/numeric-custom

created_at.description: optional original journal append time; absent on records written by older boxes

payload.description: content frame; shapes normed by protocol/fixtures (v1 content family) + blob xfer refs

presence.description: app → CLI control frame reporting foreground/background. Post-hello only; identity is the authenticated session (no device_id). No response, cursor, ack, persistence, or mailbox item.

live_activity_token.description: app → CLI authenticated post-hello ActivityKit registration. Device and room identity come from the session. An empty token idempotently unregisters job_id; a valid unknown or finished job is ignored.

agent_state.description: Transient live-state snapshot. Additive: `state` carries whatever the box knows (harness/model/effort identity, runs, schedules); a client reads the fields it understands and ignores the rest.

seq.description: Transient sequence. NOT a journal cursor - never acked, never resumed from.

agent_catalog.description: Transient list of the models this box's harness can actually select (model catalog amendment 2026-07-20). Sent to a device on subscribe and re-broadcast on change. A box that sends none leaves the client on its curated fallback - absence IS the compatibility story, so there is no version flag.

source.description: Which precedence branch the harness took: an operator scope, the harness's own setting, or everything with a credential.

truncated.description: The list was cut at the box's cap. The free-text escape still reaches the rest.

id.description: CANONICAL id, exactly as it must be sent back in a set_sdk_config (pi: provider/id).

available.description: The box holds a usable credential for it. Absent reads as false.

typing.description: Transient typing hint from the box.

read.description: Transient read cursor, fanned out to every device. Best-effort; max-merged by the box.

sdk_config_result.description: Transient, per-device answer to a set_sdk_config control (SDK-settings amendment 2026-07-19). Sent ONLY to the device whose control it answers, correlated by `rid` - there is no other correlation and no confirm frame. Success echoes the accepted post-trim values for exactly the fields the request carried ("" echoes as "" = cleared; an absent field stays absent). `restart:true` means persisted plus a supervisor bounce, and the post-restart welcome identity is the confirmation; `hot:true` means applied to the LIVE session and persisted after the harness confirmed, and the next agent_state carrying the new value is the confirmation. Neither flag = a no-op (already effective). Old apps ignore the unknown `t`, so this is additive.

rid.description: Echoes the request id. Device-scoped and CSPRNG-random from a current app, so it names one operation unambiguously.

model.description: Present iff the request carried model. "" = cleared to the harness default.

effort.description: Present iff the request carried effort. "" = cleared.

restart.description: Persisted and a supervisor bounce was requested.

hot.description: Applied to the live session, no bounce. Serialized only when true.

unverified.description: The applied model was syntactically valid but ABSENT from the harness's catalog, which under-enumerates live-valid ids. The apply landed; an API rejection may surface on the next turn and is recoverable by switching back. Present only on an ok hot result, and only when true.

code.description: On ok:false. Closed set: unsupported_harness | invalid_model | invalid_effort | empty_request | persist_failed | restart_failed | apply_in_progress, plus the hot-path additions unknown_model | no_api_key | apply_failed | no_session | harness_unreachable.

fleet_state.description: Transient operator-awareness snapshot of the box's fleet (a2a-design-v2 §6, Lane L4). Same transient family as agent_state: seq'd, never durable, never acked, never replayed. A FULL SNAPSHOT - the app replaces its whole fleet view with `state.edges` each frame (add/remove/liveness all converge). Sent ONLY to active operator devices (a device right after its mailbox drains, and every active device on a throttled >=30s change); NEVER to a fleet-session peer. Carries counts/liveness/flags ONLY - never peer message text, cid, kind, from, peer name/fp, room, url, or secret. A box that has never held a fleet edge emits nothing. Old apps ignore the unknown `t`, so it is additive.

seq.description: Transient sequence. NOT a journal cursor - never acked, never resumed from.

edges.description: Always an array (never null). Empty means no edges to show.

edge_id.description: Durable edge address (not the renameable alias).

connected.description: Real in-box liveness from the live serve/dial session map.

pending.description: Unacked outbound depth derived from the durable journal WAL.

dead.description: Tombstoned edge (removed | revoked | unreachable). Absent reads as false.

key_mismatch.description: Trust-on-first-use safety signal: the peer's key changed. Absent reads as false.
